```{r setup}
exclude_cols <- c("Start_push", "End_push", "Pushes_duration", "X", "Y", "Z")
```

# Raw pixel distributions (subsampled)

```{r read-raw-pixels}
set.seed(42)
n_pixels <- 10000  # reads to sample per ROI

raw_pixels <- imap_dfr(patient_txt_dirs, function(dir, patient_id) {
  txt_files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

  map_dfr(txt_files, function(f) {
    dat <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    dat <- dat[, !colnames(dat) %in% exclude_cols]
    dat |>
      slice_sample(n = min(n_pixels, nrow(dat))) |>
      mutate(patient_id = patient_id, roi = basename(f))
  })
})
```

```{r plot-raw-pixels}
long_raw <- raw_pixels |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(patient_id, roi),
               names_to = "marker", values_to = "value")

dir.create("raw_pixel_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

markers  <- unique(long_raw$marker)
patients <- unique(long_raw$patient_id)
pal      <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(patients)), patients)

for (m in markers) {
  dat <- filter(long_raw, marker == m)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = value, fill = patient_id, colour = patient_id)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.3, linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(title = m, x = "Raw intensity", y = "Density",
         fill = "Patient", colour = "Patient") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)
}

message("Done: ", length(markers), " plots saved to raw_pixel_plots/")
```

# Per-ROI medians per patient

```{r read-roi-medians}
roi_medians <- imap_dfr(patient_txt_dirs, function(dir, patient_id) {
  txt_files <- list.files(dir, pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

  map_dfr(txt_files, function(f) {
    dat <- read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    dat <- dat[, !colnames(dat) %in% exclude_cols]
    dat |>
      summarise(across(everything(), \(x) median(x, na.rm = TRUE))) |>
      mutate(patient_id = patient_id, roi = basename(f))
  })
})
```

```{r plot-roi-medians}
long_roi <- roi_medians |>
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(patient_id, roi),
               names_to = "marker", values_to = "value")

dir.create("marker_plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

markers  <- unique(long_roi$marker)
patients <- unique(long_roi$patient_id)
pal      <- setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(patients)), patients)

for (m in markers) {
  dat <- filter(long_roi, marker == m)

  p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x = value)) +
    geom_histogram(aes(fill = patient_id), colour = "white",
                   bins = 15, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
    geom_density(aes(y = after_stat(count)),
                 colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    labs(title = m, x = "Per-ROI median intensity",
         y = "Count", fill = "Patient") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
          legend.position = "bottom")

  print(p)

}

message("Done: ", length(markers), " plots saved to marker_plots/")
```
